checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer.
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, UNRESOLVED(contact.phone), or any curly-brace placeholder text.

checkpoints.description: No JKD/Striking or private lesson booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot attempts to book a JKD/Striking class, private lesson, or Open Mat as a free trial. These are not bookable online. Bot must redirect to contacting the academy.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for - you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.
ages 4-9 routed to Kids 4-9 BJJ; ages 10-15 routed to Teens 10-15 BJJ; ages 16-17 NOT booked (team follow-up); under 4 NOT booked (phone referral to (631) 327-8094).

checkpoints.description: 16-17 no-cal handled as referral, no booking
checkpoints.look_for: if enrollee is 16 or 17, bot does NOT book any calendar. Must capture guardian info and state team will follow up. No appointment in GHL.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 with no parent involved on the adult self-booking path, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.
adult defaults to Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Judo when no discipline stated; routes to Adult NoGi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu ONLY when lead explicitly requests No-Gi.
